{{Spoilers}} {{CharInfobox |color={{yellow color}} |corecolor={{red color light}} |bordercolor={{red color dark}} |name=Larry Turner |jname=ラリー・ターナー |tmname=Larry Turner |slogan=no |image=Detective Pikachu Returns Larry.jpg |size=280px |caption=Larry Turner in [[Detective Pikachu Returns]] |gender=Male |colors=yes |eyes=Brown |hair=Brown |hometown=[[Ryme City]] |region=Unknown |relatives=Unknown |game=yes |generation={{gen|IX}} |games=[[Detective Pikachu Returns]] |gameanim=no |pv=no |envagame= |javagame= }} '''Larry Turner''' (Japanese: '''ラリー・ターナー''' ''Larry Turner'') is a house staff member at the [[Denis Residence]] in the game [[Detective Pikachu Returns]]. ==In the games== ===[[Detective Pikachu Returns]]=== Larry is introduced at the start of the game during [[Tim Goodman|Tim]]'s first major case investigating the theft of the [[Aurora Drop]]. He is a staff member at the [[Denis Residence]], with his main duties including managing the house and groundskeeping. He is also involved in food preparation. Larry is later revealed by Tim and Pikachu to be the thief of the Aurora Drop. He is revealed to have laced the Pokémon's food with {{m|Sleep Powder}}, causing the Pokémon of the house to fall asleep and allowing Larry to take the key off [[Sanjeev Denis|Sanjeev]]'s {{OBP|Growlithe|Detective Pikachu}} and access the storage room containing the Aurora Drop. With the assistance of wild {{p|Whimsicott}} and {{p|Pawniard}} (who slices the glass container protecting the Aurora Drop), Larry gets his partner {{p|Cramorant}} to swallow the jewel and run away. Once apprehended by Tim and Pikachu, Larry reveals that he had teamed up with [[Unitas|someone he barely knew]] in exchange for material rewards which would have led to an easier life. Larry is shown to be imprisoned in the ending credits. ===Personality and characteristics=== Larry appears to be relatively naive and misguided, as he partners with someone he had barely known to orchestrate the theft of the Aurora Drop. He is also shown to lack competence in his job, as he still struggles to maintain his formal speech when working, despite having worked at the Denis Residence for some time.
